mapper.select: SELECT a.song_id, a.score_version, a.audio_url, a.bpm, a.bpm_unit, a.duration_ms, a.start_offset_ms, a.content_type, a.sha256 FROM song_model_audios a JOIN songs s ON s.id = a.song_id AND s.score_version = a.score_version LEFT JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.bpm = s.default_bpm AND a.bpm_unit = COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit'))) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.score.scoreVersion')) = 'INTEGER' AND JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.score.scoreVersion') = s.score_version AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit')) AS BINARY) = a.bpm_unit
